budget_protection.to_be_implemented: Stage 3b item 7 (launcher), verified with mocks before any paid call
budget_protection.reservation: before each sample and before each independent judge batch, check the remaining budget and reserve that unit's estimated cost; a unit does not start when the remaining budget cannot cover its reservation
budget_protection.in_sample_controls: token_limit, working_limit and per-request max_tokens (token_limit and max_tokens set after A/B selection and approved before the first real pilot run)
budget_protection.settlement: after a sample or judge batch ends, update the persistent ledger from actual usage x applicable unit prices, split into input, output, cache read, cache write, judge and billable retries; release the reservation exactly once
budget_protection.unknowns: when usage or billing for some retries cannot be isolated, record them as estimated or unknown and treat them conservatively; never fabricate precise cost
budget_protection.ledger: persistent JSON ledger; survives restarts with accumulated cost and open reservations; reservations and settlements are distinct records; idempotent settlement per execution uuid; atomic writes
budget_protection.inspect_supplement: inspect_ai 0.3.286 eval() accepts cost_limit (per-sample dollars, requires model cost data via set_model_cost() or model_cost_config) and model_cost_config (dict of model -> ModelCost); usable as a per-sample supplement, not a replacement for the pilot-wide ledger
budget_protection.not_a_hard_cap: a sample already running can push the cumulative actual cost above the ceiling; no per-request interception inside the agent loop and no monkeypatching of providers
budget_protection.atomicity: reservation atomicity under concurrency is verified before any formal run with concurrency above 1
budget_protection.price_tiers: each model call is priced at the standard or the long-context tier by its own prompt size (per-call usage from the Inspect log ModelEvents); cache writes are priced at the conservative longest-retention rate because the usage record does not split retention tiers; aggregated usage whose total prompt exceeds a threshold is priced entirely at the long-context tier and flagged; usage without a reliable price is settled at max(priced part, reservation), flagged estimated_unknown_cost and holds further starts until a recorded manual review
budget_protection.engineering_failures: an error returned in the Inspect log (fail_on_error=false) and a launcher exception are both persisted as engineering_failure events; the second occurrence of a class is a stop condition; a settlement above 2x its reservation records a stop; stop state survives restarts; ledger events are schema-validated and an unknown event type refuses to load

layer_1_inspect_model_request.timeouts_revised_2026_11_01: timeout_s 1800 -> 2700 and attempt_timeout_s 600 -> 900 for streamed responses of up to 32,000 output tokens at high effort; max_retries unchanged
layer_1_inspect_model_request.default_if_unset: unlimited retries (GenerateConfig.max_retries docstring: 'defaults to unlimited'); never leave unset

layer_2_provider_sdk.mechanism: anthropic / openai: passed as a model creation arg (eval(model_args={'max_retries': 0})); Inspect forwards unknown model_args to AsyncAnthropic(**model_args) / AsyncOpenAI(**model_args). google: NO model arg (harness.launcher.sdk_model_args): google.genai.Client has no max_retries parameter (dev batch 2026-11-01: TypeError before any request, unit held and reconciled per docs/status.md), and google-genai 2.34.0 never retries unless HttpOptions.retry_options is set (_api_client.retry_args(None) -> stop_after_attempt(1)); Inspect's provider sets none, so SDK retries are 0 for Google by default
layer_2_provider_sdk.verification: closed 2026-11-01: AsyncAnthropic.max_retries == 0 with the arg (offline construction); AsyncOpenAI accepts max_retries (constructor signature); google client constructed offline through Inspect's provider with no model args, retry_options None (harness/tests/test_generation_config.py)
layer_2_provider_sdk.sdk_default_if_unset: 2 retries with short exponential backoff on connection errors, 408, 409, 429, >=500; default request timeout 600 s (Anthropic Python SDK docs and openai-python README, queried 2026-10-30)
layer_2_provider_sdk.worst_case_if_default_kept: 4 Inspect attempts x 3 SDK attempts = 12 HTTP attempts per request

layer_3_sample_rerun.note: whole-sample reruns off; an errored sample stays in the log and its run_outcome records execution.status=error; no unapproved whole-sample or whole-task rerun

layer_4_eval_set_task_retry.retry_attempts: not applicable to eval(); if eval_set() were ever used, retry_attempts=0 is mandatory
layer_4_eval_set_task_retry.evidence: inspect_ai 0.3.286 _eval/evalset.py l. 487: num_retry_attempts = 10 if retry_attempts is None; eval() path has task_retry_attempts, set to 0 in all harness tests and in the launcher

retries.retry_cost: billable retries are counted in the budget ledger; when their usage cannot be isolated they are recorded as estimated or unknown and treated conservatively

grading.grader_version_scheme: every grading pass records grader_version = '<engine_version>+<task_grader_version>', the engine and task versions separately, and the full git commit of the grading code (grading.grade.code_provenance); the engine covers extraction, recalculation, outcome gate, scoring, pass selection, judge and review infrastructure; each task specification carries its own version; superseded value: grader_version grading-1137e2bb-2026-10-31 (pre gold-first fixes)
grading.judge_input_manifest: grading.judge.build_units_1137e2bb (task requirement, criterion, independent reference, deliverable excerpt per unit); other tasks: Stage 3 work
grading.outcome_gate: harness.collect.load_run_outcome through grading.grade.grade_run (identity from the completed Inspect log; integrated 2026-10-31, mock-verified)
grading.entry_point: grading.run_grading (one saved run: run.json / .eval / task id binding, host-only materials, grade_run; judged pass behind the judge gate, reserved and settled on the run's bound ledger) -> grading.grade.grade_run: load_run_outcome(for_grading=False) with identity from the completed Inspect log, terminal-log join, attribution routing, deterministic checks, judge units, grades.jsonl and results.jsonl (one results record per grading pass; select_pass picks one pass per run)
grading.debug_set: grading/debug_set.json (criteria used with the stub judge; excluded from judge validation)
grading.grader_version_check: grading.run_grading refuses to grade when engine_version or the task's task_grader_versions entry differs from the code (grading.grade.ENGINE_VERSION, <task module>.VERSION)

limit_labels.cost-capped: Inspect's per-sample cost_limit actually fired: SampleLimitEvent type 'cost' with limit and running value kept in run_outcome.json execution.limits
limit_labels.budget-limited: time_limit, working_limit, message_limit or token_limit actually fired: the SampleLimitEvent (type, limit, message, event uuid) kept in execution.limits
limit_labels.output-capped: a single generation was cut by max_tokens, established by the provider's stop signal (StopReason 'max_tokens' in the ModelEvent output), never by output length alone; not a sample-level budget exhaustion; detection logic is a pre-freeze TODO
limit_labels.multiple_limits: when one execution triggers several limits, every event is kept and reported; no collapsing into one cause
limit_labels.grading: limited attempts follow grading_decision and run_outcome.json: budget exhaustion is not a harness error; collection faults and execution errors are attributed independently
limit_labels.comparability: the cost safety net is not a primary limit on A/B results; identical dollar or token caps are not identical compute budgets across providers

batches._scheme: run classes with separate execution artifacts, Inspect logs, ledger, manifests and run inventory under ~/turing-eval-runs/<label>/; reservations are FORECAST pre-run estimates passed as --estimate-usd; budget_ceiling_usd is a start gate on that class's ledger, never a billing cap; cost_limit_usd (when set) replaces generation.cost_limit_usd as Inspect's per-sample safety net for that class only (formal keeps the generation value)

dev.purpose: grader development examples: one Gemini Flash sample per selected task; outputs are opened only after the task's Grader v0 is committed and tagged
dev.message_limit_policy: Gemini development and validation classes only (approved by the human 2026-11-01, chat): no Inspect message limit (null). The 7,200 s time and working-time limits, the 20,000,000 token limit, the 10 USD per-sample Inspect cost limit, the reservation and every ledger stop condition are unchanged; the candidate classes (compat, formal) carry no override and inherit generation.message_limit 200. Supersedes the 200-message dev attempt of b5d2e6f1 (run LJbb8ZyPWZgPE8VCFRbLGD, kept as a diagnostic run outside the canonical set).
dev.inspect_max_retries_policy: Gemini development and validation classes only (approved by the human 2026-11-01, chat). Inspect GenerateConfig.max_retries 10 (retry layer 1; the candidate classes inherit retries.layer_1_inspect_model_request.max_retries 3). Not model-visible; nothing is forwarded to google.genai and no other retry or backoff layer is added. Applies to units launched under a config snapshot that carries it; units under the previous snapshot (max_retries 3) stay canonical and keep their records.
dev.credential_policy: approved by the human 2026-11-01 (chat): each Gemini class uses its own Paid Tier 1 Google project; the launcher puts the named variable's value into GOOGLE_API_KEY of the unit's own process (never the scheduler's), removes the VS Code markers that make Inspect's eval() reload .env with override, refuses GEMINI_API_KEY / VERTEX_API_KEY / GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI, re-checks the key suffix after Inspect's .env initialisation and records the variable name and 4-character suffix only
dev.recovered_retry_settlement_policy: approved by the human 2026-11-01 (chat), Gemini dev and validation only: when every usage-less model event of a unit is an HTTP 429 or 5xx attempt that Inspect retried successfully within the same turn (a later call reports usage; the failed output is not in the transcript) and the unit completed or reached an accepted resource limit with collected artifacts, the unit is settled at reported usage plus one average metered call (per-unit buffer), marked inferred (not provider-confirmed), without a hold; failed-attempt counts, usage, the buffer calculation and the dashboard reconciliation requirement are recorded. Any other missing usage keeps the hold. The 2x estimate stop, per-unit reservations, the ceiling and the append-only ledger are unchanged.
